description: This file defines the OpenClawChatViewModel class, a central component for managing chat interactions, session state, message processing, and transport communication within a chat UI SDK. It includes methods for sending messages, handling events, managing sessions, models, and tools, as well as health checks and attachments.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: Main view model managing chat state, sessions, model choices, message exchange, event handling, and UI logic for the chat interface.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and initializes the chat session, bootstrap process.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the chat state by re-initializing the bootstrap process.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Triggers sending a user input message.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches and updates session list from backend.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches the current session to another specified session key.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Selects the thinking level for the session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects the model for the current session.
